items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I don’t know Mulgrew that well, I mean I’ve played with him a little bit.

ctx.x: You’re not in the minor leagues now, when you’re with those guys.

Well yeah you’ve got to bring it. They bring it. Playing with Joe Lovano is no joke, because people want to [inaudible] okay just to give you an example and it’s not just to talk about Joe, but to give you an example of a guy people have many opinions. Because people sometimes they don’t understand the music. Joe Lovano is on a high level. He’s one of the best saxophone players I’ve ever heard. And he’s definitely one of the best players I’ve ever played with. And if you want to hang with someone like that you…
As long as they don’t think that you’re just treading water or something, that you come to play.
